name: pearson_correlation
desc: Federated Pearson correlation with p-values and confidence intervals. Computes correlations for all pairs between variables and optional covariates.
label: Pearson Correlation

y.label: Variables
y.desc: Numerical variables for the primary axis of the correlation matrix.

x.label: Covariates (optional)
x.desc: Optional numerical variables for the secondary axis. If empty, uses the same variables.

alpha.label: Confidence level
alpha.desc: Confidence level used to compute correlation coefficient intervals.
